title: What it must be able to do
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: what the utility must be able to do, whoever does it. Capabilities in levels, each with an owner, a heat map of where it hurts, and the depth where the map stops.
howto: Paper notes are drafts; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Amber is the strategy layer, where capabilities sit. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side.
